name: chatbot
description: Visitor chatbots for third-party websites. Each chatbot is a non-interactive Elowen account of kind chatbot bound to exactly one managed Project, and visitors reach it through the customer's own website. The widget posts to the public hook /hooks/chatbot/v1, the plugin issues a server-signed visitor token, and every admitted message starts a real Elowen turn owned by that chatbot account through the host relay. The plugin never calls a model itself.

configSchema.label: Visitor sessions
configSchema.hint: How long an anonymous visitor may keep talking before the website has to ask for a new visitor token.

configSchema.label: Visitor token lifetime (days)
configSchema.hint: A visitor token is the only authority an anonymous visitor has. When it expires the widget asks for a new one and the conversation continues in the same session; a token is never extended automatically.

strings.title: Chatbots
strings.workspaceIntro: Chatbots answering visitors of third-party websites. Each one works inside exactly one managed Project, and its conversations belong to its own account.
strings.botsSearch: Search by name, account or public ID…
strings.botsEmptyDescription: Create a chatbot account, bind it to one managed Project and allow the domains it may answer on.
strings.botsNoResultsDescription: Change the search or the filter.
strings.botsLoadError: The chatbots could not be loaded
strings.detailSelectHint: Select a chatbot in the register to configure it.
strings.detailFactsHint: Live facts about the account this chatbot runs as.
strings.detailProjectNone: This account has no active managed Project, so a turn cannot run.
strings.detailProjectSeveral: This account has {count} active managed Projects. Exactly one is required.
strings.accountUnknown: The account carrying this chatbot no longer exists.
strings.accountNotChatbot: This account is not a chatbot account, so its turns would not be non-interactive.
strings.accountAdmin: An administrator account cannot carry a chatbot.
strings.promptHint: Stable instructions added to every turn this chatbot runs. Visitors never see them.
strings.promptPlaceholder: For example: help visitors fill in the contact form, and confirm with them before anything is submitted.
strings.originsHint: Every request must carry an Origin header matching one of these exactly. A visitor token issued for one domain never works on another.
strings.originsEmpty: No domain is allowed yet, so this chatbot answers nobody.
strings.originsInsecure: Only https is allowed once the chatbot is enabled.
strings.originsInvalid: Enter a domain as scheme://host without a path, for example https://www.example.cz.
strings.originsDuplicate: That domain is already in the list.
strings.securityHint: What this chatbot may do on a visitor's page, per domain and path. With no rule for a domain, its own per-turn ceiling governs every action the page allows.
strings.securityHelp: A rule is the allowlist of the path it names: the longest matching path prefix wins, and an action the rule does not list is refused there. A limit never raises the plugin's own per-turn ceiling.
strings.rulesEmptyHint: Without a rule this chatbot may use any action its own per-turn ceiling allows.
strings.ruleOriginHint: Only a domain this chatbot is allowed on can carry a rule.
strings.ruleOriginNone: Add an allowed domain above before writing a rule.
strings.rulePathHint: A path starting with /, for example /contact. It covers that path and everything under it.
strings.rulePathInvalid: Enter a path starting with /, without spaces, a query or a fragment.
strings.ruleLimitHint: How often this action may happen within one turn.
strings.ruleLimitInvalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and {max}.
strings.ruleConfirmationHint: Only submitting a form can be confirmed; elsewhere this changes nothing.
strings.ruleDuplicate: That domain, path and action are already listed.
strings.action_focus: Move the cursor to an element
strings.toolsHint: What this chatbot's account can reach right now. The grants themselves are edited on the Users screen, which owns that rule.
strings.toolsLoadError: The account's tools could not be loaded
strings.toolsEmptyDescription: This account reaches no tools at all.
strings.toolsMissing: These tools the chatbot needs are not granted: {names}
strings.embedHint: Goes into the customer's website. The public ID identifies the chatbot and is not a secret.
strings.embedCopyFailed: The snippet could not be copied. Select it and copy it manually.
strings.limitsHint: Every number is enforced by the server before a visitor's message is admitted, and none of them has a default. This chatbot cannot be enabled until all the required ones are set.
strings.limitsMissing: Set these numbers before this chatbot can be enabled: {fields}
strings.limitsRange: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.
strings.limit_maxConcurrentTurns: Turns running at the same time
strings.sensitiveBody: Identity numbers and addresses are not handled yet. Where such data would be processed and how long it would be kept has not been decided, so this chatbot refuses that mode instead of storing a setting it cannot honour.
strings.enableBody: The public hook starts admitting visitors from the allowed domains, and every message spends this chatbot's own account.
strings.disableBody: The public hook stops admitting visitors immediately. Conversations already recorded stay in the transcript.
strings.saveFailed: The changes could not be saved
strings.conversationsLoadError: The conversations could not be loaded
strings.conversationsEmptyDescription: A conversation appears here once a visitor's first message has been admitted.
strings.transcriptLoadError: The conversation could not be loaded
strings.transcriptEmptyDescription: This conversation holds no turn the plugin kept.
strings.transcriptNoReply: No answer was published for this turn.
strings.statsLoadError: The statistics could not be loaded
strings.chartHint: Turns this chatbot admitted, per UTC day, and the ones that failed.
strings.statsEmptyDescription: This chatbot admitted no turn in the selected window.
strings.totalsHint: Read from this plugin's own records over the selected window.
strings.totalQueuedHint: Turns admitted and not started yet, whatever day they arrived on.
strings.queueWaitHint: Time between a turn being admitted and starting, over the turns that started in this window.
strings.queueWaitHelp: Nearest-rank percentiles: half of the turns waited less than the p50, and 95 percent of them less than the p95. A dash means no turn in this window ever started.
strings.spendHint: Read from the instance's spend rollup for this chatbot's own account, over the same window.
strings.spendLoadError: The account spend could not be loaded
strings.spendEmptyDescription: This account settled no turn in the selected window, or the rollup does not carry it.
strings.spendCostHint: Token counts and price come from the instance's spend rollup, which begins on the day tracking started. A dash means no turn in the window reported a price.
strings.spendPricedTurnsHint: Turns whose provider reported a price, out of every settled turn in the window.
strings.spendOriginsHint: How many separate addresses or platforms this account's spend came from.
strings.spendTrackingSince: The spend rollup tracks from {day}; earlier turns have no recorded origin.
strings.createUsernameHint: The account is created as a non-interactive chatbot account. It cannot sign in and cannot be an administrator.
strings.createAccountHint: Only accounts that are not administrators can carry a chatbot.
strings.createDisplayNameHint: Shown to visitors in the chat panel.
strings.createProjectHint: Exactly one active managed Project. The chatbot works inside it and owns the transcript.
strings.createProjectNone: No managed Project is currently available.
strings.createFailed: The chatbot could not be created
strings.createPartial: The account exists, but this step failed: {step}. Correct it and try again.

strings.appearanceIntro: Set how the panel looks on the customer's website. The preview follows every change; nothing is saved until you save.
strings.appearancePreviewHint: This is exactly what a visitor of the website will see.
strings.appearanceNameHint: Shown to the visitor in the panel's header and beside its answers.
strings.appearanceModeHint: Switching the mode sets the panel's default colours. Each one can still be changed on its own.
strings.appearanceIntroHint: Shown while the conversation is empty. An empty field means the built-in greeting in the page's own language.
strings.appearanceIntroPlaceholder: For example: Hello, I can help you fill in the form.
strings.appearanceAvatarHint: An image address starting with https://, or an image embedded as data:image/…. An empty field means no image.
strings.appearanceAvatarInvalid: Enter an address starting with https:// or an image embedded as data:image/….
strings.appearanceQuickHint: Buttons under the greeting while the visitor has not written yet. Clicking one sends its text as their message.
strings.appearanceQuickPlaceholder: For example: I want to fill in the form
strings.appearanceQuickDuplicate: That button is already in the list.
strings.appearanceQuickFull: No more buttons can be added.
